findings.description: The bucket is explicitly annotated as public in the configuration, exposing the customer-master.xlsx object and all other contents to unauthenticated read access from the entire internet. No ACL, bucket policy restriction, or public access block is configured to constrain this exposure.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so customer data stored in this bucket (including the uploaded customer-master.xlsx object) is stored unencrypted at rest.

No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so financial data stored in this bucket is stored unencrypted at rest, exposing it if the underlying storage is accessed or the bucket is misconfigured.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational data in this bucket is stored unencrypted at rest even though versioning is enabled.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so data stored in this bucket is stored unencrypted at rest despite having access logging and versioning enabled.
